facts.business: Shah Metacorp Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in trading and manufacturing activities with overseas customers, and has investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures.

auditor.name: M/s. Mehul Raval and Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on long outstanding trade receivables of Rs. 76.26 Crores from an overseas customer with provision of Rs. 56.89 Crores; share warrants and equity shares issued on preferential basis; acquisitions of stakes in General Capital and Holding Company Private Limited (85.60%) and Metacorp Trading LLC (80.00%) via share swap; investment of USD 1 Lakh in Shah Metacorp Holding USA Inc. making it a Joint Venture; Rights Issue up to Rs. 50 crore approved; equity investment of Rs. 52,000 for 26% stake in Strike Eco Grid Private Limited making it an Associate.

key_risks: Long outstanding trade receivables from overseas customer with recoverability uncertainty
Dependence on settlement of export dues under MOU
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were approved by the Audit Committee, at arm's length and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict. Loans to subsidiaries, joint venture, and promoter companies are unsecured, payable on demand, with interest per Section 186. Details in Notes to Standalone Financial Statements and Annexure F.
